service_description: Peinture sur mur humide actif (source d'infiltration non traitée)
reason: Active moisture source (roof leak, pipe leak, rising damp) must be resolved before any paint is applied. Painting over active moisture provides no lasting result and creates artisan/client dispute risk. FIXEO must route to Plomberie, Toiture, or Maçonnerie first.

Active mold requires specialist remediation. Anti-mold paint alone is insufficient for active biological growth. Moisture source must be identified and treated. Cosmetic repainting after mold treatment is in-scope, but mold remediation itself is not.

service_description: Fissures structurelles (fissures de structure, mouvements de bâtiment)
reason: Structural cracks require engineering assessment and masonry repair before painting. Painting over structural cracks provides no repair and creates liability. FIXEO must route to Maçonnerie.

service_description: Réparation bois avant peinture (bois pourri, assemblage cassé, charpente)
reason: Wood repair, rot treatment, or carpentry fabrication must precede painting. Wood repair is Menuiserie scope.

service_description: Infiltration toiture (peinture plafond après dégât des eaux par toiture)
reason: Roof infiltration causing ceiling stains must be treated at source (Toiture) before ceiling repaint. FIXEO must not create a service that encourages masking active water damage.

service_description: Peinture tadelakt (hammam, salle de bain, piscine)
reason: Tadelakt requires specialized artisan skills, multi-day application, specific lime materials, polishing and waterproofing soap finish. Price range 300–600 MAD/m² is evidence-supported but artisan evaluation is mandatory. Cannot be standardized without site inspection.
Scaffolding for multi-story facades significantly increases cost and requires safety assessment. Scaffolding rental adds 15–40% to total project cost. Cannot be standardized without site measurement.

service_description: Stucco vénitien, badigeons, béton ciré, effets spéciaux
reason: Decorative finishes (80–200+ DH/m²) depend heavily on artisan skill and specific technique. Cannot be standardized without artisan assessment.
Large-scale commercial/promoter painting requires negotiated volume rates, project management, and scheduling coordination. Not appropriate for FIXEO residential artisan model in V1.

service_description: Peinture epoxy sol (garages, parkings, locaux industriels)
reason: Floor epoxy paint is a different specialty from residential wall painting. Different surface preparation, materials, and artisan profile.
Insufficient specific Moroccan evidence for shutter painting pricing. Likely in-scope for Peinture V2 but evidence base is too thin for V1.
Metal surface preparation (sanding, anti-rust primer, finish coat) requires different materials and process from wood. Insufficient specific Moroccan evidence for V1 standardized price.
Facade render + paint is a complex construction task requiring mason skills, material assessment, and surface preparation that goes beyond painting scope. Combines Maçonnerie (enduit) and Peinture.
Any electrical modifications, fixture changes, or circuit work must be completed before painting. Routes to Electricité.
